name: Pixel DMG
source: original — the palette is the Game Boy DMG's canonical four green shades (#0f380f #306230 #8bac0f #9bbc0f), extended one step at each end so WCAG-AA text can exist on a reflective LCD
use_when: retro-computing and emulator pages, chiptune and game tools, playful portfolios and 8-bit microsites that want one screen and four greens
